description_for_human: Universal OAuth Broker + Capability Gateway: connect OAuth providers once, grant capabilities to agents, invoke third-party APIs without exposing tokens.
description_for_model: CNothing v2.5 MCP. Agent NEVER receives OAuth tokens, API keys, or client secrets. Flow: list_capabilities → request_authorization (returns approval_url) → user approves in browser → get_authorization_status → invoke_capability. Use v2.5 agent API only. v1 kv_* and authai_* tools are deprecated internal tools — do not use for OAuth or capability workflows.

auth.instructions: Agent uses agent_access_token on v2.5 agent endpoints. Human OAuth and capability approval happen in browser at approval_url only.

tool_groups.name: deprecated_v1
tool_groups.description: Deprecated v1 internal tools — hidden from default manifest

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List available capabilities with schemas and authorization status. Never returns tokens or invocation secrets.

tools.name: request_authorization
tools.description: Request user approval for a capability. Returns approval_url for browser. Do not pass user_id.

tools.name: get_authorization_status
tools.description: Poll authorization status after user opens approval_url.

tools.name: invoke_capability
tools.description: Invoke an approved capability. Agent never receives third-party tokens.

tools.name: list_grants
tools.description: List capability grants for this agent.
